pipeline test_direct(harness: Harness) {
  return Err("direct failure")
}

pipeline test_propagated(harness: Harness) {
  Err("propagated failure")?
  throw "propagation did not return"
}

pipeline test_ok(harness: Harness) {
  return Ok(nil)
}

pipeline test_value(harness: Harness) {
  return 42
}
